tha-ap48:1.1: lokanāthamhi vipassimhaggapuggale suphullapadumaṁ → lokanāthambhi vipassimhaggapuggalo suphullaṁ padumaṁ (bj)
tha-ap48:1.2: vipassimhaggapuggale suphullapadumaṁ → vipassimh aggapuggale suphullaṁ padumaṁ (pts) | aggapuggale → S1 G. Vipassi aggapuggale. (pts note) | suphullaṁ → G. suphullapadumaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap48:1.4: citamāropayiṁ → citakamāropayiṁ (bj) | ahaṁ → tadā (bj: sīmu) | citam → All MSS. read cittam. (pts note)
tha-ap48:2.2: nabhamuggami ākāse chadanaṁ → nabhamuggamī ākāsacchadanaṁ (bj) | vehāsaṁ nabhamuggami ākāse chadanaṁ → vehasan nabham uggamiṁ ākāsacchadanaṁ (pts)
tha-ap48:2.3: ākāse chadanaṁ → ākāsacchadanaṁ (sya-all) | chadanaṁ → ākāsacchadanaṁ (cck: sī.) | uggamiṁ → G. uggamī. (pts note)
tha-ap48:2.4: citakamhi adhārayi ekanavutito → citakambhi adhārayiṁ ekanavute ito (bj) | adhārayi ekanavutito → adhārayiṁ ekanavute ito (sya-all, pts) | adhārayiṁ → adhārayi (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap48:4.1: sattatālīsito → sattatāḷīsito (bj, sya-all) | kappe → S2 sattacattālīsakappe. (pts note)
